_comment: Scene 8 = DROID-PanClean (ported from PolaRiS owhan/PolaRiS-Hub `pan_clean`). Task: 'Use the yellow sponge to scrub the blue handle frying pan' -- pick up the sponge and put it in the frying pan. Objects are PolaRiS's scanned USDZ meshes (custom/pan_clean/) spawned via kind:'usd_rigid'; the frying pan is the fixed TARGET (kinematic, like PolaRiS's kinematicEnabled pan) so it cannot be knocked away, and the sponge is the pick object (randomized per env, see eval/scene_specs.py::SCENES[8]). We keep PolaRiS's per-object scales (the USDZ meshes are in arbitrary units); non-uniform scale (sponge) is supported. All meshes are XY-centered with their base at local z=0, so pos.z = table-top rest height (our table top ~0.045-0.05). Base scene8_0.usd = empty table+dome+robot. NOTE: this is a first-cut layout adapted to our smaller workspace (x~[0.30,0.60], y~[-0.12,0.24]); verify object placement / sponge graspability / pan reach in a smoke render and nudge poses if needed. Distractors are a curated subset of PolaRiS's clutter (full library in custom/pan_clean/).
